title: Erdős #650: optimal bounds for matching integers to distinct multiples

original_sources.citation: Erdős Problems #650: estimate the optimal uniform guarantee for matching distinct integers to distinct multiples.
Formal Conjectures, ErdosProblems/650.lean at the fixed commit; definition f and exact-formula target parts.i, used as a pending statement source.

scope: For every natural number m, prove the uniform matching guarantee f(m) = min(m, ceil(2 * sqrt(m))), using A ⊆ {1,…,N}, real starts x ≥ 1, natural-number right endpoints, and open intervals. The bridge from the candidate encoding, including m = 0, remains pending review.
